export type ChartCurve = "smooth" | "linear";

types.declaration:
/** Compact trend presentation, shared by both native renderers. */
export type SparklineVariant = "line" | "area" | "bar";
types.name: SparklineVariant

props.description: The observations to plot, in order from left to right; the position in the array is the x position.
props.name: values

props.description: `line` (default) shows the trend; `area` fills it to zero; `bar` draws one vertical column per observation, diverging around zero for negative values.
props.name: variant

props.description: Accessible description of the trend.
props.name: label

props.description: The Series Role (1–6) the trend is drawn in. Never the Brand red.
props.name: series

props.description: Explicit color custom-property name; omitted, keeps the DS series role.
props.name: color

props.description: Positive line/area outline width in drawing pixels; defaults to 2.
props.name: strokeWidth

props.description: `smooth` (default) uses monotone interpolation through the observations without local overshoot; `linear` joins them with straight segments. Applies to line and area; columns are unchanged. Values and statistics are unchanged.
props.name: curve

props.description: Drawing width in px. Omitted, fills its container; an explicit width keeps a fixed drawing.
props.name: width

props.description: Fixed drawing height in px. Omitted, one and a half rows of the Density's control height.
props.name: height

props.description: When LayerChart loads: `lazy` (default) once the figure nears the viewport, `eager` as soon as it mounts. Until then — and in the server render — the figure holds a placeholder of the chart's own Density-sized height under its accessible name.
props.name: loading

props.description: Extra classes merged onto the chart's root figure.
props.name: className
